page.title: Alert e-mail
page.leaveConfirm: A template has unsaved changes. Leave this page and lose them?
page.leaveRecipient: A recipient has not been saved. Leave this page and lose it?
page.leaveBoth: A template has unsaved changes and a recipient has not been saved. Leave this page and lose both?

forbidden.heading: Alert e-mail cannot be shown to this account.
forbidden.body: Needs the <perm>admin:notifications</perm> permission. Nothing was changed.

error.advice: Nothing was changed. Check the backend, then try again.

relay.heading: Relay

notConfigured.heading: No alert e-mail can leave this site.
notConfigured.body: SMTP_HOST is empty. Set it in .env, restart, reload. Read the guide.

insecure.heading: No alert e-mail is sent with this configuration.

status.note: Configured means a host is set, not that the relay answers.

relay.envNote: Set in .env, read-only. The password is never shown. How the relay is set.

editor.heading: {label} template

state.defaultOwn: The stored default, sent by every type without its own.
state.defaultOff: The default template is stored but off; the shipped one is sent.
state.defaultNone: No default template is stored; the shipped one is sent.
state.typeOff: The {label} template is stored but off; these alerts send {fallback}.
state.typeFallback: {label} alerts send {fallback}. Saving stores a template for this type.

editor.subject: Subject
editor.textHint: Empty derives it from the HTML body.
editor.sanitiserChanged: The sanitiser changed your HTML; the editor shows what is stored.
editor.sanitiserKept: The sanitiser kept the HTML as typed.
editor.resetDefaultBody: Deletes the stored default; e-mail returns to the shipped template.

resetTypeBody.default: Deletes the stored {label} template; these alerts send the default.
resetTypeBody.shipped: Deletes the stored {label} template; these alerts send the shipped one.

placeholders.heading: Placeholders
placeholders.unavailable: Placeholders could not be read; reload to try again.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.failed: The preview could not be built.
preview.failedAdvice: Correct the template and update. Nothing was saved.
preview.outOfDateNote: The editor has changed since this preview was built.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.scaleActual: Shown at 100 %. Scroll inside the preview.

test.heading: Send a test message
test.note: Sends the current editor text to one mailbox. Limit {limit}.
test.noteNoLimit: Sends the current editor text to one mailbox.
test.notConfigured: No relay is configured; set SMTP_HOST in .env.
test.settingsUnread: Relay settings could not be read; test send is off.
test.acceptedHeading: The relay accepted the test message.
test.failedHeading: The test message was not sent.
test.retryLater: Wait a minute, then send again.
test.notSent: The test message was not sent.
test.unknownOutcome: The relay reported an outcome this page does not word.

next.sent: Check the mailbox, junk folder included. Acceptance does not prove delivery.
next.not_configured: Then restart the backend and worker and reload.
next.insecure_login: Restart the backend and worker, then send again.
next.auth_failed: Correct the credentials in .env, restart, then send again.
next.recipient_refused: Try another mailbox, or ask the relay's administrator.
next.sender_refused: Ask the relay's administrator which senders it accepts.
next.server_error: Read the relay's own log; its reply text is never shown here.

recipients.heading: Recipients

nobody.heading: No alert e-mail is sent.
nobody.noneStored: No recipient is stored and NOTIFY_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS is empty.
nobody.allOff: Every stored recipient is off and NOTIFY_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS is empty.

recipients.removeBody: This address stops receiving alert e-mail at once.

env.heading: From .env
env.note: From NOTIFY_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS: every alert, LOW and above. Read-only.

form.typesNone: Choose at least one alert type.
form.typesUnavailable: Alert types could not be read; reload to retry.
form.enabled: Send alert e-mail to this address
